base: Use case: ui-mockup. Rune Nexus mobile tower defense proposed UI design board. Use attached ACTUAL GAME screenshots as visual reference. CRITICAL every battlefield must look like THIS GAME: small simple stylized turrets, thick mossy square tiles with tan stone path, flat purple ground portal, small cyan crystal core, plain dark teal void, exact reference art direction. No castle scenery, armies, cinematic fantasy landscapes, invented realistic cannons or huge architecture. UI can be thoughtfully redesigned beyond screenshot: deep ink blue surfaces, precise cyan selection lines, restrained brushed blue metal edging, modest chamfered corners, clear readable Korean typography, original gem socket round metal forms and existing icon vocabulary. NO heavy silver medieval frames, no excessive neon, no SaaS pills. Design clean, compact high-quality practical mobile game interface. Output ONE landscape 3072x2304 design board with THREE equally sized portrait mobile screens side by side, clean dark margin, numbered short Korean labels above. Each screen full screen 9:19-ish proportions, comfortably readable, no physical phone shells. Maintain identical reusable UI system across screens. Battlefield contextual background identical game to references; the focal panels can occupy lower 35-45 percent when necessary, modal states dim same battlefield. All in-game screens, no lobby. Preserve functionality described. Values are illustrative not balance changes. No invented functions. Make UI materially improved: strong title-action hierarchy, generous touch targets without oversized panels, fewer nested borders, primary vs secondary buttons clear. Gold for currency, cyan for action, orange only destructive, green reward, violet portal.
